==Biography==
Nicolás Raúl Sayago was born in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

=== 2014 Season===
His debut was in [[Coliseo Dragons]] as Support where he participated in [[Argentina National League 2014/Season 1|ANL 2014 Season 1]] being one of the four classifiers. Already in the [[Riot Latin America Cup 2014/Chile Qualifiers|LAC 2014 Chile Qualifiers]] they were not able to classify the group stage. I participate in [[Argentina National League 2014/Season 2|ANL 2014 Season 2]] where the team was one of the 6 classified. Already in the [[Riot Latin America Cup 2014/Argentina Qualifiers|LAC 2014 Argentina Qualifiers]] they were not able to classify the group stage. I participate in [[Argentina National League 2014/Season 3|ANL 2014 Season 3]] being one of the four classifiers. Already in the [[Riot Latin America Cup 2014/Colombia Qualifiers|LAC 2014 Colombia Qualifiers]] they were not able to classify the group stage. At the end of these tournaments [[Fix]] remains on the team.

=== 2015 Season===
I participate in the [[Circuito de Leyendas Sur/2015 Season/Opening Season|CDLS 2015 Opening Season]] where the team was third in the tournament. At the end of this tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2017 Season===
I enter the [[Bencheados]] team as AD Carry participating in the [[CDLS 2017 Opening]] where the team came second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CDLS 2017 Opening Playoffs]] the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Promotion]] they faced [[Hafnet eSports]] where they lost 3-0, unable to qualify. At the end of this tournament, fix leaves the team.

In the middle of the year he enters [[Kaos Latin Gamers]] as AD Carry participating in the [[CLS 2017 Closing]] where the team is first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Playoffs]] the team faces [[Isurus Gaming]] where they win 3-1, qualifying for the first time to the World Cup. Already in the World Cup, he faced two teams [[Young Generation]] and [[Fnatic]] where they could only beat the Vietnamese.

=== 2018 Season===
Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team is second in the tournament, qualifying for the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] where the team reaches the final facing [[Rebirth eSports]] where they win 3-2, qualifying for the first time to the MSI. In the MSI they were in group A facing [[Gambit Esports]], [[Lyon Gaming (2017 Latin America North Team)|Lyon Gaming]] and [[Ascension Gaming]] where they had very close games, but could not qualify for the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final again facing [[Rebirth eSports]] winning 3-1, qualifying for the second time to the World Cup. Already in the World Cup he was in group D with [[Gambit Esports]], [[Dire Wolves]] and [[G-Rex]] losing all the games.

=== 2019 Season===
This year [[Kaos Latin Gamers]] is left alone with [[Nate]] and [[Fix]] renewing their other roles participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] where the team was last in the tournament. At the end of this tournament, Fix says goodbye to the team where I stand out.

In the middle of the year he enters [[XTEN Esports]] as AD Carry participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was sixth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase and leaving the team.

At the end of the year, fix with his girlfriend [[Paulaeal]] founded their new team [[Humanoids5]] participating in the [[Circuito Nacional Chile/2019 Season/Closing Season|CNC 2019 Closing Season]] where the team came third in the general tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LHE 2020 Opening Promotion]] the team reaches the final facing [[FroztFire Team]] where they win 3-0, qualifying the [[LHE 2020 Opening]]. At the end of this tournament, fix retires as a player and stays as manager.

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Vayne}} and {{ci|Caitlyn}}.
* Reached Challenger on the Korean server.
* They call him "the Humble."
* He is the founder of [[Humanoids5]].
